row:
Hey there! We’re Rehab United, proudly recognized as one of San Diego’s top-rated physical therapy clinics. Our mission is simple: to empower you with the knowledge and tools to prevent injuries, manage chronic pain, and master effective rehabilitation exercises.

Whether you're recovering from an injury, rehabbing post-surgery, or aiming to improve your overall mobility, our channel is dedicated to helping you reach your fitness and wellness goals. Our approach combines Applied Functional Science® with a hands-on perspective. 

But what truly drives us? It’s the joy of seeing you get back to doing the things you love, pain-free and stronger than ever. Join us on your journey to better health and movement!
